controller.prompt: If all points are configured for all parts, jump to step 12. If not, jump to step 7.
If every puncture site is configured, jump to step 20. If not, jump to step 15.

cb_step_1.title: Select the CT volume
cb_step_1.instruction: Choose the CT volume to process.

cb_step_2.title: Continue from image loading
cb_step_2.instruction: Click Next in the '1. Load Image Volume' page.

cb_step_3.title: Adjust the view
cb_step_3.instruction: Rotate or zoom the view to clearly see the ROI.

cb_step_4.title: Choose instrumentation options
cb_step_4.instruction: Pick the instrumented levels, number of sides, and approach direction.

cb_step_5.title: Continue to ROI definition
cb_step_5.instruction: Click Next in the '2. Define Surgical Region of Interest (ROI)' page.

cb_step_6.title: Enable slice intersection interaction
cb_step_6.instruction: Turn on slice intersection visibility, enable Set interaction, then turn on Translate and Rotate.

cb_step_7.title: Adjust the red slice view
cb_step_7.instruction: Rotate or zoom the red slice view to the desired angle.

cb_step_8.title: Activate point placement
cb_step_8.instruction: Click the 'Place a control point' button to activate placement.

cb_step_9.title: Add fiducial points for one spine part
cb_step_9.instruction: Click in the 2D views on one part of the spine to add the fiducial points, then click Done.

repeat.summary: One part of the spine per pass.

cb_step_10.title: Stop point placement
cb_step_10.instruction: Click the 'Place a control point' button again to stop placement.

cb_step_11.title: All points configured for all parts?
cb_step_11.instruction: Choose Yes if every part is done; choose No to continue with the next part.

cb_step_12.title: Disable slice intersection interaction
cb_step_12.instruction: In the slice intersection interaction options, turn off Set interaction.

cb_step_13.title: Set level, side, and landmarks
cb_step_13.instruction: Set the level, side, and landmarks in the selection widget.

cb_step_14.title: Continue to landmark placement
cb_step_14.instruction: Click Next in the '3. Place the Landmarks' page.

cb_step_15.title: Choose puncture site and screw diameter
cb_step_15.instruction: Select the puncture site and the screw diameter in mm.

cb_step_16.title: Adjust the view of the puncture site
cb_step_16.instruction: Rotate or zoom the 2D views to clearly see the puncture site.

cb_step_19.title: All puncture sites configured?
cb_step_19.instruction: Choose Yes if every puncture site is done; choose No to configure the next site.

cb_step_20.title: Continue to screw adjustment
cb_step_20.instruction: Click Next in the '4. Adjust Screws' page.

cb_step_21.title: Grade the screws
cb_step_21.instruction: Click Grade Screws to generate the grading table.

cb_step_22.title: Review the grading table
cb_step_22.instruction: Review the generated Grade Screws output table.

cb_step_23.title: Continue from grading
cb_step_23.instruction: Click Next in the 'Grading Step' page.

operation_descriptions: Enable slice intersection visibility and enable set interaction with Translate and Rotate.
Disable the set interaction option for slice intersections.
Advance from the Load Image Volume page to the ROI definition workflow.
Manually adjust the boundaries of the ROI.
Manually adjust the boundaries of the ROI.
Advance past the surgical ROI definition page to the next workflow page.
Enable slice intersection visibility and enable set interaction with Translate and Rotate.
Manually adjust the rotation angle of the red slice.
Manually adjust the rotation angle of the red slice.
Activate the control point placement mode.
Deactivate the control point placement mode.
Disable the set interaction option for slice intersections.
Advance past the Place the Landmarks page to the next workflow page.
Manually adjust the start and end position of puncture site in 2D views.
Manually adjust the start and end position of puncture site in 2D views.
Apply the updated puncture site settings with the Update button.
Confirm and close the screw adjustment dialog with OK.
Advance past the Adjust Screws page to the next workflow page.
Run screw grading with the Grade Screws button.
Advance past the Grading Step page to finish the workflow.

        raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: IntersectingSlicesInteractive")

    # Enable the Translate interaction handle.
    sliceDisplayNode.SetIntersectingSlicesTranslationEnabled(True)
    if not sliceDisplayNode.GetIntersectingSlicesTranslationEnabled():
        raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: IntersectingSlicesTranslationEnabled")

    # Enable the Rotate interaction handle.
    sliceDisplayNode.SetIntersectingSlicesRotationEnabled(True)
    if not sliceDisplayNode.GetIntersectingSlicesRotationEnabled():
        raise RuntimeError("STATE_NOT_APPLIED: IntersectingSlicesRotationEnabled")

# Workaround to force visual update (see https://github.com/Slicer/Slicer/issues/6338)
sliceNodes = slicer.util.getNodesByClass("vtkMRMLSliceNode")
for sliceNode in sliceNodes:
    sliceNode.Modified()
